QuestInfo.name: The Alien Mainframe
QuestInfo.0: Get back into the alien base and sabotage their work.
QuestInfo.1: Destroy the #b#o9400802##k. Be careful, it won't be easy!

0.0: The next step is to take down the #b#o9400802##k, their living mainframe! It's enormous and REALLY tough, so...good luck with that.
0.1: Think you can handle it? Are you ready to mess up some aliens?

no.0: Not into the whole spy thing, huh? Well, maybe you'll care about the future of this city later.

yes.0: Ooh! Did you really destroy the #b#o9400802##k?! Amazing... you are tough as can be!
yes.1: Too bad about that matter-cloner they have, though! The #b#o9400802##k you took down is just going to get remade later. Bummer, huh? But maybe you bought us some time!
yes.2: If you want to shut down their operation, you're going to have to destroy that #b#o9400802##k a whoooole bunch of times. It may be an endless fight. That's why I'm pretty sure YOU are the perfect person to do it.
yes.3: Maybe you can help me launch a more... offensive plan! You're pretty good at being offensive, after all.
yes.4: Okay, talk to me when you're in the game!
